children: Amass Brands CFO Zachary Ament will resign effective November 16, 2026, and Geoffrey McFarlane will become interim CFO the following day.
Interim Chief Financial Officer; principal financial officer and principal accounting officer
Not due to a disagreement with the company regarding its operations, policies, practices, financial disclosures or accounting matters.
To serve while the company searches for a permanent CFO.
Geoffrey McFarlane will serve as interim CFO.
The company is searching for a permanent CFO.
Company consultant since August 2025; previously served as interim CFO from July 2024 to August 2025. Co-founded Westbound & Down Brewing Company and Winc Wines.
Compensation arrangement is under negotiation; no compensatory plan, contract or arrangement has been entered into or materially amended.
